short: Explain what a KV cache is in two sentences.
medium: A language model generates text one token at a time. For every new token it must attend to all earlier tokens, so the keys and values computed for earlier positions are stored and reused instead of being recomputed. This stored state is called the KV cache. It grows linearly with the length of the conversation and with the number of layers and attention heads, and it competes with the model weights for memory. Serving systems therefore spend much of their effort deciding which cache entries to keep, share, compress or evict. A language model generates text one token at a time.
